summary: Patriot Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 16,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $160 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Underwriters have a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 2,400,000 additional units. Agreements include underwriting, warrant, and investment management trust agreements. This is a routine IPO closing report, not a special situation. No unique catalyst, unusual governance change, or strategic event is present. The filing is a standard capital-raising current report with no special-situation classification.
